items.headline: Source: Saints' Zach Wood to miss time with Grade 2 calf strain
items.description: Saints long-snapper Zach Wood has a Grade II calf strain that could sideline him about 4-6 weeks, a source told ESPN.

items.headline: Saints' Alvin Kamara practices in full, 'in a great place'
items.description: Saints coach Kellen Moore said he "feels good" about Alvin Kamara's chance of playing Sunday. The veteran RB was a full participant in Wednesday's practice.
